verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships as a Python framework with an installable CLI (`crewai run`, `crewai test`) and exposes REST endpoints (kickoff/status/resume) for headless execution and automation, which are naturally scriptable in CI pipelines without any GUI dependency; the Visual Builder features are optional AMP add-ons, not required for headless use. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/CD example (e.g. GitHub Actions workflow) and independent community confirmation of running CrewAI in CI.
